title: BDC2026 reproducible baseline recovery V3
objective: Restore a provenance-aware, rerunnable BDC2026 baseline in the formal dev worktree by reconciling the BDC2026-test snapshot, frozen-data manifest, executable entrypoints, tests, V2 state, and evidence without rewriting historical loops.
success_criteria: Every restored or modified formal-repository file has documented provenance and explicit user approval
The frozen market CSV matches the declared cutoff, schema, row count, stock count, MD5, and SHA-256, or a newly generated manifest records a separately approved replacement dataset
XGBoost train and predict entrypoints execute offline against the frozen data and produce a schema-valid Top5 result
Unit and generated acceptance tests pass for label endpoints, full-week policy, cutoff, missing weeks, duplicate keys, holdout isolation, and submission schema
The clean-room Transformer, XGBoost, and naive baselines can be compared on identical folds with absolute portfolio return as the primary metric
Goal, Loop, handoff, evidence index, reflection, and audit state can be recovered by a fresh agent using repository-relative paths
No historical Loop-001 through Loop-008 conclusion is rewritten

verification.pass_criteria: Harness is valid and reports the V3 recovery Goal and new recovery Loop
All unit and generated acceptance tests pass without network access
Frozen data and constituent files match the approved manifest and cutoff
Offline baseline training and prediction complete and output/result.csv passes schema validation
Loop state, handoff, evidence paths, and indexed hashes are valid

constraints: Do not read market data on or after 2026-06-29 for training, validation, feature generation, or selection
Do not modify an existing file without explicit user approval of the target and intended change
Do not train or predict with network access
Do not overwrite production configuration during recovery
Use repository-relative paths and record the real executor for every handoff
Do not commit raw CSV, models, output, temp, dist, or release bundles
Treat BDC2026-test as a recovery source, not as validated evidence by itself
non_goals: No model-family promotion during baseline recovery
No claim of global optimality or superiority to the official implementation
No rewriting of Loop-001 through Loop-008
No remote push or release until the corresponding gate and user authorization are satisfied
blockers: The approved frozen market CSV cannot be recovered or regenerated with traceable source and hashes
Recovery-source semantic differences cannot be attributed or safely reimplemented
Offline entrypoint or acceptance validation cannot run within the declared environment
A required existing-file change is not approved by the user
iteration_priority: Recover and verify frozen data provenance
Reconcile code provenance and restore minimum executable entrypoints
Reconcile V2 evidence and only then resume structure experiments
Run release verification after baseline validation
